## Market.getMaxCapacities() method

Returns the maximum capacity for all interactions with Morpho Blue given a certain position and loan and collateral balances.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getMaxCapacities(position: {
        collateral: bigint;
        supplyShares: bigint;
        borrowShares: bigint;
    }, loanTokenBalance: bigint, collateralTokenBalance: bigint, options?: {
        borrow?: MaxBorrowOptions;
        withdrawCollateral?: MaxWithdrawCollateralOptions;
    }): MaxPositionCapacities;
```
